programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Design X Stories
programme.desc: Today's theme: Compact. This is the key to comfort in limited space, giving rise to designs that fold, layer, and enclose. Explore the beauty and potential in Japan's wide variety of compact designs.

programme.title: Let's Enjoy MATH
programme.desc: Numbler comes and distracts a boy trying to count his cows at a farm. Barky helps with the counting by grouping the cows into units of 10.

programme.title: TAKE TECH
programme.desc: A program for upper primary to lower secondary school children to explore the everyday technologies all around them. Each episode takes a piece of familiar tech to find out what it does and how.

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: The winner of 11 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director and Best Actor, Ben-Hur stands as one of the greatest Hollywood epics ever filmed.

programme.title: The Enforcer
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Clint Eastwood returns as Dirty Harry Callahan in this hard-edged thriller. San Francisco police inspector Harry Callahan is assigned a female partner (Tyne Daly), but he has little time to express his displeasure because terrorists kidnap the mayor. Now no holds are barred when Dirty Harry goes into action.

programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
programme.desc: Stone Age Earth: In the presence of a mysterious black obelisk, pre-humans discover the use of tools--and weapons--violently taking first steps toward intelligence. 1999: On Earth's moon astronauts uncover another mysterious black obelisk. 2001: Between Earth and Jupiter, the spacecraft's intelligent computer makes a mistake that kills most of the human crew--then continues to kill to hide its error. Beyond Time: The sole survivor of the journey to Jupiter ascends to the next level of humanity.

programme.title: Superman Returns
programme.desc: In a soaring new chapter in the epic story of the Man of Steel, Superman Returns to fight for truth and justice and protect the world he loves from cataclysmic destruction!

programme.title: Cry Macho
programme.desc: A former rodeo star and washed-up horse breeder goes on a redemptive journey to Mexico to retrieve his ex-boss' son in this moving drama.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 19
programme.desc: The CBI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town when the owner is found dead. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to find out how much Patrick knows about Red John.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 20
programme.desc: J.J. LaRoche personally requests Jane's help when the mysterious container he's had hidden in his safe for nine years is stolen from his home.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 21
programme.desc: When Wolowitz gets tow work with world-renowned scientist STEPHEN HAWKING (guest starring as Himself), Sheldon is willing to do anything to meet his hero.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 22
programme.desc: Howard's wedding plans are in jeopardy after the guys (and Wil Wheaton) throw him a bachelor party and details of his sexual history are leaked online.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 23
programme.desc: When NASA reschedules Howard's mission and puts his wedding plans in jeopardy, he's forced to face his fears and Bernadette's dad (guest star CASEY SANDER).

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 24
programme.desc: When Howard and Bernadette decide they want to be married before his NASA space launch, the gang rushes to put on a wedding, on the fifth season finale.

programme.title: Friends S6 16
programme.desc: In the friends' continuing speculative fantasy, Ross initiates a threesome with his wife and her female friend--and gets left out.

programme.title: Friends S6 17
programme.desc: Chandler and Monica agree to give each other homemade presents for their six-month anniversary.

programme.title: Friends S6 18
programme.desc: When a fire damages their apartment, Rachel and Phoebe must choose between living temporarily with Joey or Monica. Ross gets into trouble by dating a student. Chandler tries to help Joey's career.

programme.title: Friends S6 19
programme.desc: Ross worries when his student/girlfriend goes on vacation with her wild friends. Rachel needs a date for a ball. Joey's refrigerator breaks down.

programme.title: Friends S6 20
programme.desc: In this episode primarily composed of clips from earlier shows, Joey auditions for a major television role. But Chandler almost ruins everything by forgetting a telephone message.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S1 1
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. Sal, Murr, Q, and Joe serve up some mischief at White Castle, take on tourists in Times Square, and check out customers in a warehouse store.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S1 2
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. The guys get liberal with lotion down at the shore, shop from other people's carts in a supermarket, and try to scam their way to a free dish of yogurt.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S1 3
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. The guys approach strangers with humiliating one liners on the streets of New York, play a unique word game in a grocery store, and try to get shoppers to hop in a trunk at a car dealership.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 12
programme.desc: When Viola Smith visits her son, Will, in Bel-Air for Thanksgiving, she fears he's not being taught the value of work and turns the household upside down to correct the situation.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 13
programme.desc: When Will and Carlton find out that Hilary has dropped out of college without telling her parents, the boys force her to do whatever they want.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 14
programme.desc: Will, \"The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air,\" gets into trouble during his very first day at Bel-Air Prep School.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 15
programme.desc: Will's plan to get Ashley Banks into the Christmas spirit by garishly decorating the exterior of the Banks residence only succeeds in upsetting the neighbors.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 16
programme.desc: Philip risks losing a big account when he advises a superstitious client to stop allowing Will's spontaneous remarks to influence business decisions.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy's First Marriage S1 12
programme.desc: Georgie worries he’s letting his family down when he’s forced to stay home with a cold, and Mandy worries about how her career will affect her marriage.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy's First Marriage S1 13
programme.desc: Jim feels ganged up on when Georgie and Audrey make changes to the tire store, and Mandy helps Georgie navigate a fight between her parents.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy's First Marriage S1 14
programme.desc: Mandy finds out Meemaw runs an illegal sportsbook and decides she wants in on the action. Meanwhile, Georgie struggles to keep Mandy’s new job a secret.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy's First Marriage S1 15
programme.desc: Georgie helps Connor impress his new crush, while Mandy, Audrey and Jim struggle to butt out of Connor’s love life.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy's First Marriage S1 16
programme.desc: Georgie and Mandy worry they’re not on the same page when they disagree about having another kid, and Mary, Jim and Audrey struggle to stay out of it.

programme.title: Friends S6 16
programme.desc: In the friends' continuing speculative fantasy, Ross initiates a threesome with his wife and her female friend--and gets left out.

programme.title: North By Northwest
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars as an innocent man mistaken for a spy in one of director Alfred Hitchcock's greatest thrillers. While leaving New York's Plaza Hotel, advertising executive Roger Thornhill (Grant) has the misfortune of standing just as the name \"George Kaplan\" is paged--starting a lethal case of mistaken identity and a nonstop game of cat and mouse as he is pursued across North America by espionage agents trying to kill him--and by police who suspect him of murder.

programme.title: East Of Eden
programme.desc: Hollywood legend James Dean stars in this adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic novel East of Eden. Teenaged Cal Trask (Dean--Rebel Without a Cause, Giant) longs for the affection that his father reserves for his brother Aron, but his efforts meet only rejection. Also attracted to Aron's girlfriend, Cal becomes so frustrated in his search for love and acceptance that he reveals a long-held secret about their mother to Aron . . . knowledge that now tears the family apart.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.

programme.title: Body Of Lies
programme.desc: Trust no one. Deceive everyone. When idealistic CIA agent Roger Ferris (Di Caprio -- The Departed, Blood Diamond) is stationed in Jordan after being wounded in Iraq, he dedicates his life to stopping further attacks by Al Qaeda. Following a plan that the British employed successfully against the Nazis, Ferris plants the suspicion among the terrorists that their leaders are collaborating with the Americans. But as the stakes rise and Ferris finds himself in the crosshairs, the plot he starts spirals into an outcome he could never have foreseen.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Kegelisahan seorang pemuda keturunan Afrika-Amerika terhadap sambutan orangtua kekasihnya yang berkulit putih mencapai puncaknya saat ia mengunjungi mereka di akhir pekan.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: Avengers: Black Widow &...
programme.desc: Punisher bekerja sama dengan Black Widow dalam misi berisiko tinggi untuk menghentikan Leviathan, organisasi teroris yang berusaha menjual teknologi curian S.H.I.E.L.D., demi menyelamatkan dunia dan para Avenger.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm menyamar sebagai pengusir setan yang selalu berpindah tempat. Mereka lalu mendapati sebuah kutukan dunia dongeng yang menuntut keberanian sejati, bukan ritual palsu yang biasa mereka lakukan.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2154, orang kaya menghuni sebuah stasiun ruang angkasa dan orang miskin tinggal di planet Bumi. Seorang pria menjalankan misi untuk membawa kesetaraan bagi dunia nan bertolak belakang tersebut.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War

programme.title: The Mummy

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel melakukan segala cara untuk merekrut murid-murid baru ke Miyagi Do. Johnny memikirkan beberapa hubungan penting dalam hidupnya dan menanggapi promosi dojo milik Daniel dengan caranya sendiri.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel melakukan upaya lain untuk mempromosikan Miyagi Do, dan menerima bimbingan dari sosok yang tidak asing. Johnny mencurigai latar belakang Kreese. Seorang murid baru Cobra Kai menantang Miguel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel berupaya untuk membantu seorang siswa baru belajar. Miguel memulai hubungan baru, sementara Johnny mencoba memperbaiki hubungannya. Ketegangan yang terjadi antara kedua dojo semakin meningkat.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Murid-murid Daniel diajarkan untuk mengatasi dendam mereka. Johnny meninggalkan dojo untuk sementara waktu, sementara Kreese menggunakan pengaruhnya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Untuk mempersiapkan murid-muridnya, Daniel mencoba beberapa metode pelatihan baru. Miguel mempraktikkan sebuah pelajaran baru. Johnny membuat sebuah keputusan sulit namun penting yang mempengaruhi Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel berusaha berbaikan dengan Amanda, sementara Johnny menggunakan sebuah aplikasi kencan. Ketegangan terjadi saat Miguel, Samantha, Robby dan Tory bertemu.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Johnny mencoba berkencan, sementara Daniel dan Amanda menikmati kencan nan romantis. Sebuah upaya untuk menyatukan murid-murid dari kedua dojo menjadi bumerang saat permusuhan para remaja justru memanas.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Ini hari pertama sekolah di SMA West Valley, namun ketegangan antara kedua dojo belum juga mereda seiring berakhirnya musim panas. Persaingan antara Daniel dan Johnny mencapai puncaknya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel tengah berjuang untuk bertahan hidup, Robby menghilang, sementara reputasi Daniel dan Johnny hancur saat masyarakat mendapatkan informasi terkait perkelahian di West Valley.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel dan Johnny bekerja sama untuk mencari Robby. Miguel menghadapi masa depan yang tidak pasti. Kreese berusaha untuk membuat Tory kembali ke Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Citra buruk Daniel di mata publik berdampak negatif pada penjualannya, hingga memicu tawaran akuisisi. Johnny berusaha mengumpulkan dana untuk operasi Miguel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Setelah menghadiri pertemuan penting di Jepang, Daniel kembali mengunjungi kampung halaman Tn. Miyagi di Okinawa. Johnny berusaha memperbaiki hubungan dengan Robby.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Di Okinawa, Daniel menghabiskan waktu bersama seorang teman lama dan seorang musuh lama, yang memiliki banyak hal untuk diajarkan kepadanya. Persaingan kedua dojo tersebut semakin sengit.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel membantu Johnny merancang unggahan media sosial yang sempurna. Kreese mencari calon anggota baru, sementara Daniel dan Amanda berusaha menutup Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel menghabiskan waktu bersama putrinya, Sam, yang mengalami trauma. Johnny berencana untuk membuka dojo karate baru tapi ia kesulitan menemukan nama yang keren.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Setelah diberitahu bahwa Turnamen Karate All Valley tahun ini dibatalkan, ketiga guru bela diri yang saling berkompetisi menghadiri rapat dewan kota untuk mencegahnya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Suasana romantis dan perayaan Natal di Valley semakin terasa. Daniel dan Miguel menemukan kesamaan yang tak terduga, dan para anggota Cobra Kai pergi untuk menjalani sebuah misi.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Keadaan mulai membaik saat pesta Natal klub, tapi sebuah serangan brutal yang dilakukan oleh murid-murid Kreese menyebabkan pengkhianatan dan munculnya aliansi baru.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: 34 tahun setelah kalah dalam Kejuaraan Karate All Valley, Johnny Lawrence memutuskan untuk membuka kembali Dojo Cobra Kai sementara lawannya di sekolah, Daniel LaRusso, menjalankan sebuah bisnis otomotif yang sukses.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Daniel merasa kesal saat mengetahui bahwa Dojo Cobra Kai yang baru telah dibuka. Johnny mengetahui bahwa dojo miliknya harus memenuhi beberapa persyaratan keselamatan sebelum ia dapat mulai mengajar.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Miguel membantu Johnny mengiklankan Cobra Kai di sebuah halaman situs. Daniel setuju untuk datang ke sebuah pesta dansa Halloween agar ia bisa mengawasi putrinya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Robbie tengah bersitegang dengan ayahnya. Johnny berencana menutup Cobra Kai setelah Miguel terluka. Hubungan Samantha dan Kyler di ambang kehancuran. Sementara, sebuah papan reklame yang dirusak membuat Daniel marah.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Cobra Kai mendapatkan murid kedua. Daniel menyusun rencana rumit untuk membalas dendam pada Johnny. Miguel membela Samantha saat berhadapan dengan Kyler di jam istirahat makan siang.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Kelas dojo Johnny menarik sekelompok orang dengan karakter nan unik sementara putranya, Robby, yang memiliki motif tersembunyi, mendapatkan pekerjaan baru. Samantha mendapat teman baru di kelas sains.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Saat Johnny mengetahui Cobra Kai dilarang mengikuti Turnamen All Valley, ia menghadap Dewan Kota. Miguel mengajak Samantha berkencan. Robbie belajar dari Daniel saat teman-temannya berencana mencuri dari LaRusso Auto.

programme.desc: Johnny mempersiapkan murid-muridnya di Cobra Kai untuk mengikuti Turnamen Karate All Valley berikutnya dan ia pun terinspirasi untuk menata kembali hidupnya. Daniel masih belum mengetahui latar belakang murid barunya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Tindakan sembrono Louie memaksa Johnny dan Daniel untuk mengenang masa lalu mereka. Murid-murid Cobra Kai merencanakan balas dendam terhadap anak-anak yang populer. Miguel merasa jengkel dengan Samantha.

programme.title: Rush Hour

programme.desc: When his former superior, Colonel Samuel, asks him to join him on a special mission in Afghanistan, Rambo declines. However, when he is held hostage and tortured, Rambo decides to step in.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson trains with Rocky Balboa, the legendary boxer. Following Rocky's guidance, he works hard to earn recognition in the boxing world.

programme.desc: Optimus Prime seeks his creator in space. Meanwhile, humans and Autobots join forces to save Earth from an ancient threat.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt fights against a rogue terrorist and rushes to prevent a deadly virus from spreading. To avert a global catastrophe, Ethan has to bring everything to an end.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: An ex-MI6 agent steals a hard drive with top-secret information to carry out a vendetta on Bond's overseer, M. Bond must face his past in a bid to try and save M.

programme.title: Absolute Deception
programme.desc: Rebecca Scott, a widowed reporter, teams up with an FBI agent to uncover the mystery of her husband's death. However, things take a turn when they are targeted by unknown enemies.

programme.title: Snowpiercer

programme.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
programme.desc: When a hacker reveals the identities of Britain's undercover agents, British agent Johnny English springs back into action and must overcome the challenges of modern technology.
